data.one_liner: Privacy-Enhanced Mail (PEM) parser for RSA, PKCS#1, PKCS#8, and X.509 formats
data.what_it_does: Parses PEM-encoded files to extract RSA public keys, private keys, and X.509 certificates. It supports PKCS#1 and PKCS#8 formats without requiring the pointycastle package.
use_when: You need to parse RSA public or private keys in PEM, PKCS#1, or PKCS#8 formats
You need to read X.509 certificates in a Dart application
avoid_when: You need full cryptographic operations like encryption, decryption, or signing (this package only parses the keys)
strengths: Supports multiple standards (PEM, PKCS#1, PKCS#8, X.509)
weaknesses: Does not provide cryptographic functions out of the box
Limited to RSA keys and X.509 certificates
